title: Times tables: equal groups
hook: × means “groups of”. 3 × 4 is 3 plates with 4 cookies on each: 4 + 4 + 4.

atHome.ask: “3 cars in the car park. How many wheels?”
“Hold up 3 hands with me. How many fingers?”
“4 people came home. How many shoes?”
“2 boxes of 6 eggs. How many eggs?”

tips: Read 3 × 4 out loud as “3 groups of 4”, then add 4 + 4 + 4.
Counting on fingers is fine. Adding the same number again is exactly what times means.
One table a week: start with 2, 5 and 10, and use its real thing all week.
